A1.justification: Local execution and file-reading tools remained unresponsive, preventing inspection of either PDF, their appendices, and the PDF skill instructions. Research identity and material completeness could not be verified. This is an access failure, not evidence that document content is missing.

before.justification: v3.pdf could not be inspected, so the presence of original empirical results remains unresolved.

after.justification: v4.pdf could not be inspected, so the presence of original empirical results remains unresolved.

M1.justification: Neither version's method descriptions or equations were accessible, preventing comparison of algorithms and model components.

E1.justification: Dataset, task, and test-scenario coverage could not be inspected in either version.

E2.justification: Reported comparisons were inaccessible, so baseline participation could not be matched across versions.

E3.justification: Experimental settings and evaluation protocols could not be read or compared.

E4.justification: The main text and appendices were inaccessible, preventing comparison of ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and statistical reporting could not be inspected.

E6.justification: No result tables, figures, or findings could be read, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative changes.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected in either version.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were inaccessible, preventing comparison of core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be read or compared.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures could not be inspected, including those potentially contained in appendices.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and references were inaccessible, preventing comparison of citations and research positioning.

P1.justification: Document text and section organization could not be inspected, so rewriting or restructuring cannot be assessed.

P2.justification: PDF pages could not be rendered or inspected, preventing comparison of figures, tables, and layout.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF could be inspected because local reading tools remained unresponsive. Without before-and-after evidence from the papers and their appendices, the benefits, harms, and overall quality implications of the revision cannot be assessed reliably.
